prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE dialogue bust emotion variant for Terminus, based very closely on the supplied character concept. The concept is the authority for anatomy, apparent age, face geometry, hair, clothes, every accessory and design detail; do not redesign anything. Coreto style: monochrome sepia, black hand-inked outlines, dark brown crosshatching, fine stippling, light parchment highlights INSIDE the silhouette, no painted background. Keep the same stylization, relative line weights, upper-left lighting and palette as concept. ONE character only, portrait 3:4 canvas, head through waist/upper hips, complete head, ears and shoulders, hands fully within frame if shown. Leave clear transparent margins, reserve enough room for restrained gestures. Keep original facing direction and proportions. Do not add props, symbols, lettering, sweat drops, emotion icons, aura, scenery or floor shadow. Actual transparent background. Final export is 504x672; draw legibly at that scale.
Image 1 is the CURRENT CONCEPT, image 2 the checked NEUTRAL COMPOSITION. Keep image 2's camera, scale, torso placement, head size, facing direction, palette and costume. Change only expression and restrained body acting.
CHARACTER INVARIANTS: Neral TRANSFORMED: enormous pale bald hairless bestial Ignoto, huge hypertrophied shoulders and elevated trapezius, comparatively tiny bald head set forward, hunched torso, broad toothed maw, pointed ears and clawed hands. EXACT monster proportions from concept, no humanization. Same torn coat, pale trim, triangular clasps, belt, wrist remnants and fallen hood. 
PERSONALITY: Still the same calculating Neral in a huge beast body. Joy is satisfied toothy grin, sadness lowered head and heavy slack arms, anger threatening snarl, confusion tilted tiny head and asymmetrical eye narrowing. Never tame, cute, humanize or reduce muscles.
EMOTION TO DRAW NOW: FELIZ / HAPPY. Clearly readable happiness appropriate to personality: eyes brighten and soften, cheeks lift, smile or equivalent eye expression, shoulders gently relax/open. Restrained natural gesture if useful, not an exaggerated cheer.
Refinement of HAPPY acting: make happiness clearly different from neutral at small size. Broad unmistakably upward-curving satisfied grin, cheeks raised, pale eyes narrowed into pleased crescents, brow lifted and unknitted, head tipped a little back with pride, gigantic shoulders relaxed. One enormous clawed hand rests lightly against upper chest in satisfied amusement, the other remains low. It is a pleased dangerous monster, not an angry snarl or a cute human. Keep the same enormous proportions, tiny head and full costume. NO new accessories.
inspecao_visual: Conferido lado a lado: identidade, figurino, acessórios, anatomia, leitura da emoção, enquadramento e transparência. Avaliação artística do autor pendente.

tentativas_descartadas.motivo: Alegria próxima demais da expressão neutra no tamanho reduzido.

verificacao_tecnica.exportacao: Lanczos com alfa pré-multiplicado, escala proporcional, canvas transparente 504x672, alinhamento inferior, sRGB, PNG não entrelaçado.
